exposure: body morphologic measurements (BMI, skin-fold thickness, waist circumference)
cohort: The study included 329 sexually active women aged 19-52 years, who had been in a stable heterosexual relationship for at least 6 months.
finding: Increased appearance anxiety, presence of surgical scars, accompanying depression, SFT abdomen measurement, and age were significantly associated with female sexual function, with appearance anxiety showing the strongest correlation with sexual complaints in middle-aged women.
cross-section timing: The study was conducted with women aged 19-52 years, described as middle-aged.
